reviews.use_summary: Uses the R arrow package to load sparse expression matrices stored in Parquet chunks of 50,000 cells by 500 genes, and to query chunked pairwise cluster differential-expression results.
uncertainties: Specific Arrow function calls, memory-map settings and query options are unreported.
Do not conflate the R interface with PyArrow, PacBio Arrow or ordinary figure arrows.

supporting_evidence.section: Methods / scRNA-seq / Differential gene expression analysis

reviews.implementation_scope_note: Project availability: selected original R Arrow 12.0.1 Parquet chunk reads and lazy Dataset filter/select/arrange/collect queries with caller-declared local assets and options. The pinned C++ h32ed672_2_cpu recipe declares no source patches; same-version patched builds are rejected. Thirteen original controls cover ten complete returns and three original failures, including a 50,000-by-500 project fixture. The paper storage schema, exact Arrow calls, memory-map settings and query options remain unreported. Sparse-matrix conversion, live Dataset/Table pointer persistence, biological validity and paper reproduction are not qualified. Complete original conditions are retained; the missing-column trace records actual caller context. Missing/forbidden prerequisites SKIP3 skip dependent analysis; FAIL2 admits no complete result, including recording failure.
